L1 = "record bounds 5≤min s≤10^7 close Branch A" fails: minimal case k=5 — no ∀-side obstruction for min s specifically, quantifier slip confirmed, and the route continues only by renaming the difficulty (§4.1 circularity); repair = explicit m with colouring witness s≤m plus universal (m−1)-term blu

L1-as-branch-B-evidence fails: Maynard bound is subsequence-only (hidden-subsequence attack) and does not match the quantifier reversal of o(log N) (needs all-N failure at positive density, not infinitely many N); repair = uniform c·log N lower bound on the full primes, an equivalent-strength open p

Verifies f(5)=f(6)=3 only; provides no n with f(n+1)<f(n), let alone arbitrarily large ones — fails the asymptotic ∃-quantifier of the literal negation (non-result: finite-parameter values for an asymptotic claim).

Zero-step degenerate walk (S∋0, constant walk, singleton A) satisfies all stated premises and violates the conclusion; statement needs 0∉S and infinitely many distinct points before the real conjecture is engaged.

Endpoint k=ℓ=0 gives 2^0·3^0·m+1=m+1; for m=1 this is prime, so the claimed witness fails; repair: any witness construction must prove compositeness on the full lattice k,ℓ≥0 including endpoints, not just a sublattice.
